segments.name: Off-price retail
segments.description: Operates Burlington Stores, a nationally recognized off-price retailer of high-quality, branded merchandise at everyday low prices across the United States.
segments.evidence: The Company reports segment information in accordance with ASC Topic No. 280 "Segment Reporting," and has one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay Burlington for value-priced apparel, accessories, home goods and other branded merchandise purchased in its stores.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company is an off-price retailer that derives revenues from customers by providing a complete line of value-priced apparel, including: women's ready-to-wear apparel, menswear, youth apparel, baby, beauty, footwear, accessories, home, toys, gifts and coats.
